[SWS_DM_01044] Check Transmission Mode
⌈
On reception of the UDS
Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) and if the requested transmission mode
is different to a configured DiagnosticPeriodicRate.periodicRateCategory
or to ’stopSending’ , the DM shall respond with NRC 0x31 (requestOutOfRange).
⌋
